title: fix(console): a partly failed bulk approve names each failed row with its reason
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW
Fixes #36855
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/` or `content/docs/` names the Approval Center's bulk-failure string or teaches overriding it

## 维护者速读

- 审批中心里批量通过或驳回时，若部分失败，审批人现在能看到每条失败记录及其失败原因；失败太多时点“查看全部”可在弹窗里看到每一条。
- 替“批量处理审批的审批人”解决：以前只列出记录名，不说为什么失败，无从下手。
- 只改提示文案和一个只读弹窗，不改审批结果；出错最多是提示不完整，可直接撤回本改动。旧的一条提示文案退役（随 19.0.0 大版本）：自行改写过它的部署，改写不再生效。
- 无

## What changes

`runBulk` in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` caught each failure with a bare `catch` and kept only the record title. Now each failure keeps `{ id, title, reason }`, where `reason` is `humanizeError(err, tr('actionFailed', 'Action failed'))`: the same reader the single-row Approve and Reject use. It returns the server's `userMessage` (via `declaredUserMessage`) when the refusal carries one, else the page's localized line for the refusal (not allowed, already decided, no longer exists), else the error's own text (`approvalsApi.call` always sets one as `CODE: message`, so a 500 reads `APPROVAL_APPROVE_FAILED: ` plus the server's text). The generic `Action failed` is reached only by an error with no message.

The partial-failure toast is now titled "N succeeded, M failed" and its description lists the first three failed rows, one per line, as "title: reason". The toast stays until dismissed (`duration: Infinity`, close button), whatever the count. When more than three fail, it carries a "Show all (M)" action. The action closes over that run's own list: it puts that list into the dialog and opens it, so a toast still on screen after a later run shows its own rows. The dialog lists every failed row with its reason. The page dismisses its failure toasts on unmount, because their action opens a dialog that lives in the page. The dialog is rendered outside the bulk bar, so it survives the selection being cleared. The console had no existing overflow pattern for a bulk toast. The nearest ones (`AppManagementPage` bulk toggle, the Studio save bar) put all lines into one toast with no cap, which is what this card asks to avoid. So I used a toast action plus an `AlertDialog`, built from components the page already imports.

Locale packs (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, all 11): `approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` is replaced by `bulkPartialSummary`, `bulkFailureLine`, `bulkFailuresShowAll`, `bulkFailuresTitle`, `bulkFailuresBody` and `close`. Key parity holds. `zh-Hant.ts` is regenerated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`). `bulkFailureLine` is added to the `untranslated-identity` allowlist as a format string (holes and a colon), the same as `listConditions.chips.pattern`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, the `runBulk` hunk: the reason reader and the overflow branch of the toast options.
2. `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`, the new `AlertDialog` after the bulk action bar.
3. `ApprovalsInboxPage.inlineActionsVisible-34587.test.tsx`: the stub translator now interpolates `{{name}}` holes. No existing assertion in that file used a hole.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.inlineActionsVisible-34587.test.tsx` should report 10 passed. The four cases under "a partly failed bulk approve says why each row failed" are the new pins.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared inbox harness file `ApprovalsInboxPage.inlineActionsVisible-34587.test.tsx`, beside the #36463 refusal pin:
- one refused row out of two: the toast reads `1 succeeded, 1 failed`, and its description is `Bulk Invoice 2:` followed by the server's marked `userMessage`, with no overflow action;
- CONTROL: all three rows succeed, so there is one success toast, no error toast and no failure list;
- six rows with five failures (mixed marked `userMessage` and 409 already-decided): the toast lists the first three with reasons, its action reads `Show all (5)` and the toast is sticky. Clicking the action opens the dialog, and every one of the five rows appears with its own reason. The succeeding row does not appear.
- two runs on one page, first with five failures, then clean: the first toast's `Show all (5)` still opens `Not decided: 5` with rows 1 to 5. This is the L1 repro; it read `Not decided: 0` and an empty list before.

Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the reason was replaced with `''`. The mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0, blob d21c8808ce8e to 8724dfc2388a). Two pins went red (`expected 'Bulk Invoice 2: ' to be 'Bulk Invoice 2: ...'`, Tests 2 failed / 7 passed). The file was restored, blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

Second ablation (own-run list), on head e1ea082076. Two held mutations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put back the shared-state design: the action's `setBulkFailures(failures);` became `void failures;`, and `setBulkFailures(failures);` was written at the end of every run. Both landed (blob a729e1db98b7 to 7cfb74cd2d70 to c783de858825). The two-run pin went red, with the dialog reading `Not decided: 0`, which is the L1 repro (Tests 1 failed / 9 passed). Restored with `--restore`: blob equal to the HEAD blob a729e1db98b7, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Removed translation keys

`approvalsInbox.bulkPartial` (`@object-ui/i18n`, released in 18.6.0) is retired from all eleven packs it shipped in: ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans and zh-Hant. This follows the 19.0.0 key-retirement ruling (7153171432 / 7153326968). It is **BREAKING** only for a host that overrides that key: the override is no longer shown. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

No reader is left. On head 935499b5e4, `git grep` for `bulkPartial` (excluding `bulkPartialSummary`) across `ui packages apps examples skills` gave exit 1, no hits. Every dynamic `approvalsInbox.` + key construction is a wrapper: five definitions in four files (the console page's `tr`, `RecordApprovalsPanel`, two in `ApprovalDecisionPanel`, `ApprovalActionTimeline`). None of them is called with a non-literal key (`git grep` exit 1). The release tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` carries the key in all 11 packs.

## Acceptance notes

- `humanizeError`'s last fallback is `err.message || fallback`. A refusal with no `userMessage` and no recognised code or status therefore shows the error's own message, exactly as the single-row Approve does today. That keeps one reader, as the card asks. It is not narrowed here.
- The bulk Reject path shares `runBulk`, so it gets the same feedback.
